author: Computing Forever
description:
The EU has mandated that all new cars from July 7th 2026 must have cameras that monitor the driver for signs of fatigue or distraction when driving. This is part of the Advanced Driver Distraction Warning system. I discuss the various criticisms of the system and my own thoughts.
